chapter: Tulane Brass Band and bass drum
title: Learning the bass drum by watching; Ernest's drum
summary: Happy learned by watching and walking beside Ernest, tells of a parade where he outplayed him, and keeps Ernest's 24-inch bass drum.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Picking up a first guitar or banjo, self-taught
